about: Desires of the M5Stack CoreS3 body, read by desire-system through DESIRE_CONFIG_FILE (see desire-system/desire_updater.py). Names are desire-system's own, because individual-kernel and interaction-orchestrator read them. {companion} becomes COMPANION_NAME. Left out: look_outside (the body cannot see out of a window), browse_curiosity (the heartbeat has no web search) and identity_coherence (its set point of 0.9 makes it most uncomfortable right after a recall).

miss_companion.label: {companion}と話したい
miss_companion.why: m5-link records a conversation through the body as the first keyword, so talking lowers it

observe_room.label: 部屋を見たい
observe_room.why: the body's camera (body MCP see); two hours, not the ten minutes of a pan-tilt camera

body_effects.why: with little battery left, wanting anything weakens (PetitOnes' example)
being picked up or touched just now half meets wanting to be with someone
